title: 第4章 扎根日常-《70年代开局，我靠零元购发家》
content:
第(1/3)页

    日子一天天过去，王建新在草原上待了快两个月了。

    草原上的春天来得晚，但来得猛。四月底五月初的时候，草就像发了疯一样往上蹿。前几天还是黄乎乎的地皮，转眼就绿了。那绿色是一层一层铺上去的，先是淡淡的，跟泼了水彩似的，过两天就浓了，再过两天就厚实了，踩上去软绵绵的。

    羊群也跟着疯了。一个冬天没吃上好草，现在见了绿草就跟见了亲娘似的，低着头猛啃，啃得满嘴冒绿汁。小羊羔更欢实，在草地上蹦来蹦去，有时候蹦高了翻个跟头，爬起来接着蹦。

    王建新骑着马跟在羊群后面，嘴里叼着根草，眯着眼看天。天蓝得不像话，云白得也不像话。风从草原上吹过来，带着青草的味道和羊粪蛋子的味道。

    他已经习惯这个味道了。

    刚来的时候，蒙古包里的羊膻味熏得他睡不着觉，奶茶的咸腥味让他反胃，手把肉的膻味让他嚼不下去。现在这些都成了日常。不觉得臭了，也不觉得难吃了，就是生活的一部分。

    “建新——”

    远处有人喊他。王建新转过头，看见张爱国骑着马跑过来，后面还跟着两个知青，一个叫刘建国，一个叫赵红军。

    “你们怎么来了？”王建新问。

    “苏和大叔让我们来找你。”张爱国勒住马，“说让你回去一趟，公社来人了，有事找你。”

    “找我？”

    “嗯。”张爱国说，“好像是问上次李红梅生病的事儿。”

    王建新皱了皱眉。他上次用茶叶和大蒜给李红梅治痢疾的事，在知青点传开了，后来又在牧民中间传开了。其其格大妈腰疼被他按好了，苏和家难产的母羊被他救活了，这些事加在一起，让他莫名其妙在周围几个生产队有了点小名声。

    “那你们帮我看着羊？”王建新翻身上马。

    “行，你去吧。”张爱国说。

    王建新骑马往回赶。到了生产队驻地，看见一辆吉普车停在苏和家门口，这在草原上可是稀罕物件。

    他跳下马，掀开毡门进去。

    苏和坐在里面，旁边是一个穿中山装的中年男人，戴着一副黑框眼镜，看着像个干部。

    “你就是王建新？”中年男人站起来。

    “是。”王建新说。

    “我叫韩志远，是公社卫生院的。”中年男人伸出手，“听说你会看病？”

    王建新跟他握了握手：“就会一点，家里老人教的。”

    “治痢疾、治腰疼、还会给羊接生？”韩志远笑着说，“会的可不少啊。”

    王建新没说话。

    韩志远从包里拿出一个小本子：“是这样的，我们公社卫生院缺人手，尤其是懂中医的。你要是真有这个本事，可以来卫生院帮忙。不算正式工，但每天有八毛钱的补贴。”

    王建新看了看苏和。苏和抽着烟，脸上没什么表情。

    “韩同志，谢谢您。”王建新说，“但我刚来草原，活儿还没学会呢。再说了，我这点本事，也就是治个头疼脑热，真要去卫生院，我怕给人治坏了。”

    韩志远愣了一下，大概没想到一个十五岁的孩子会拒绝。

    “你再想想？”韩志远说。

    “不用想了。”王建新说，“我现在就想把放羊学好，把蒙语学好。其他的，以后再说。”

    韩志远看了看苏和。苏和吐了口烟，慢悠悠地说：“这孩子说得对，先把本分活儿干好。”

    韩志远收起本子，笑了笑：“行，那以后再说。不过你要是愿意，可以当咱们公社的赤脚医生，不用去卫生院，就在生产队给人看病。这个不耽误你干活，还能挣工分。”

    王建新想了想：“这个行。”

    韩志远在本子上记了记，又说：“过几天公社有个赤脚医生培训班，你去听听？”

    “行。”

    韩志远走了。吉普车发动起来，扬起一阵尘土，很快就看不见了。

    苏和站在门口，看着吉普车消失的方向，转头对王建新说：“你为啥不去卫生院？”

    “太远了。”王建新说，“去了那儿就顾不上放羊了。”

    苏和看了他一眼，没再问。但王建新知道苏和心里有数——卫生院在公社，离生产队五六十里地，去了就得住那儿。王建新不想离开这儿，不想离开边境线。

    “走吧，放羊去。”苏和说。

    两人骑上马，往草场走。

    一路上王建新都在想刚才的事。赤脚医生这个身份不错，不耽误干活，还能挣工分，最重要的是——能名正言顺地接触各种药材和医疗物资。这些东西，以后说不定用得着。

    而且，赤脚医生在各家各户走动，能听到各种消息。在这个年代，消息就是机会。

    “苏和大叔。”王建新说，“公社的赤脚医生培训班，您觉得我去几天合适？”

    “去呗。”苏和说，“三五天，耽误不了什么。”

    “那羊……”

    “我替你放几天。”

    “谢谢苏和大叔。”

    苏和摆摆手，没说话。

    过了几天，王建新骑马去了公社。公社离生产队五十多里地，骑马走了大半天。

    培训班在公社卫生院的一间平房里办的。来的人不多，加上王建新一共七个，都是各个生产队推荐的知青或者牧民。讲课的是韩志远，讲的内容很简单：怎么量体温，怎么用听诊器，怎么打针，怎么处理外伤，怎么辨认几种常见的中草药。

    王建新听得有点无聊。这些东西他脑子里都有，而且比韩志远讲的深得多。但他还是认真听着，时不时在本子上记几笔。不能表现得太聪明，也不能表现得太笨。恰到好处地点头、提问、记笔记。

    课间休息的时候，韩志远走到他旁边：“怎么样，听得懂吗？”

    “听得懂。”王建新说，“韩老师讲得好。”

    韩志远笑了笑：“你上次给李红梅治痢疾用的那个法子，我回去查了查，茶叶里的鞣酸确实有收敛作用，大蒜能杀菌。你姥爷教的？”

    “嗯。”王建新说，“我姥爷说，治病不一定非得用好药，用对了，家里的东西也能救命。”

    韩志远点点头：“你姥爷是个有本事的人。”

    培训班一共五天。王建新白天听课，晚上就住在卫生院后面的一间小屋里。小屋里就一张床、一张桌子、一把椅子，墙上糊着报纸，窗户上贴着窗花。

    晚上没事干，他就坐在床上练功。

    还是没感觉。

    他都快习惯了。每天盘腿坐一会儿，当是静心了。练不成就不练吧，反正还有空间和医术。

    第五天，培训班结束。韩志远给每个人发了一个小药箱，里面有红药水、紫药水、碘酒、纱布、胶布、几片去痛片。

    “回去好好干。”韩志远说，“有什么不懂的，随时来公社找我。”
    第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

Days passed by, and Wang Jianxin had been on the grassland for almost two months.

Spring on the grassland comes late, but it comes fiercely.In late April and early May, the grass was growing like crazy.The ground was still yellow a few days ago, but it turned green in the blink of an eye.The green was laid on layer by layer. It was light at first, as if watercolor had been splashed on it. After two days it became thicker, and after another two days it became thick and soft when stepped on.

The sheep also went crazy.I haven't eaten good grass all winter, and now when I see green grass, I feel like I'm seeing my own mother. I lower my head and gnaw hard, until my mouth is full of green juice.The little lamb is more lively and jumps around on the grass. Sometimes it jumps high, turns somersaults, gets up and jumps again.

Wang Jianxin followed the sheep on horseback, holding a piece of grass in his mouth and squinting at the sky.The sky is too blue to be true, and the clouds are too white to be true.The wind blows from the grassland, carrying the smell of green grass and sheep dung and eggs.

He is already used to this smell.

When he first arrived, the smell of mutton in the yurt kept him awake, the salty smell of milk tea made him nauseated, and the smell of meat in his hands made him unable to chew.Now this has become a daily routine.It doesn’t smell bad or taste bad, it’s just a part of life.

"Jianxin——"

Someone called him from a distance.Wang Jianxin turned his head and saw Zhang Aiguo running over on horseback, followed by two educated youths, one named Liu Jianguo and the other Zhao Hongjun.

"Why are you here?" Wang Jianxin asked.

"Uncle Su He asked us to come find you." Zhang Aiguo reined in his horse and said, "I asked you to go back. Someone from the commune is here and they want to see you if there is anything."

"Looking for me?"

"Yeah." Zhang Aiguo said, "I seem to be asking about Li Hongmei's illness last time."

Wang Jianxin frowned.The last time he used tea and garlic to treat Li Hongmei's dysentery, the news spread among the educated youth spots, and later among the herdsmen.He healed Aunt Qiqige's back pain, and he rescued Su He's ewe that was having difficulty giving birth. Together, these things made him somewhat famous among the surrounding production teams for no apparent reason.

"Then you will help me look after the sheep?" Wang Jianxin got on his horse.

"Okay, you go." Zhang Aiguo said.

Wang Jianxin rode back.When I arrived at the production team station, I saw a jeep parked in front of Su He's house. This was a rare thing on the grassland.

He jumped off his horse, opened the felt door and went in.

Su He was sitting inside, and next to him was a middle-aged man in a Chinese tunic suit and a pair of black-rimmed glasses, who looked like a cadre.

"Are you Wang Jianxin?" The middle-aged man stood up.

"Yes." Wang Jianxin said.

"My name is Han Zhiyuan, and I work at the commune health center." The middle-aged man stretched out his hand, "I heard that you can see a doctor?"

Wang Jianxin shook hands with him: "I know a little bit, I learned it from my old man at home."

"Cure dysentery, treat back pain, and deliver sheep?" Han Zhiyuan said with a smile, "There are quite a few people who know how to do it."

Wang Jianxin said nothing.

Han Zhiyuan took out a small notebook from his bag: "It's like this. Our commune health center is short of manpower, especially those who understand traditional Chinese medicine. If you really have the ability, you can come to the health center to help. It's not a formal job, but you get a subsidy of 80 cents a day."

Wang Jianxin looked at Su He.Su He was smoking a cigarette with no expression on his face.

"Comrade Han, thank you." Wang Jianxin said, "But I just came to the grassland and I haven't learned the work yet. Besides, my only skill is to cure a headache and a fever. If I really have to go to the health center, I'm afraid that it will be cured by others."

Han Zhiyuan was stunned for a moment, probably not expecting a fifteen-year-old child to refuse.

"Think about it again?" Han Zhiyuan said.

“Don’t think about it.” Wang Jianxin said, “I just want to learn how to herd sheep and learn Mongolian well now. I’ll talk about the rest later.”

​​ Han Zhiyuan looked at Su He.Su He blew out the smoke and said slowly: "This kid is right, do your job well first."

Han Zhiyuan put away the notebook and smiled: "Okay, we'll talk about it later. But if you want, you can be a barefoot doctor in our commune. You don't have to go to the health center, but you can treat people in the production team. This will not delay your work, and you can also earn work points."

Wang Jianxin thought for a while: "This is OK."

Han Zhiyuan made a note in his notebook and said, "There will be a training class for barefoot doctors in the commune in a few days. Do you want to go and listen to it?"

"Okay."

Han Zhiyuan is gone.The Jeep started up, kicked up a cloud of dust, and was soon out of sight.

Su He stood at the door, looked at the direction in which the jeep disappeared, turned to Wang Jianxin and said, "Why don't you go to the health center?"

"It's too far." Wang Jianxin said, "Once you get there, you won't be able to care about herding sheep."

Su He glanced at him and didn't ask any more questions.But Wang Jianxin knew that Su He knew what he knew - the health center was in a commune, fifty or sixty miles away from the production team, and he would have to live there if he went there.Wang Jianxin doesn't want to leave here, or leave the border.

"Let's go and herd the sheep." Su He said.

The two of them got on their horses and walked to the pasture.

Along the way, Wang Jianxin was thinking about what just happened.The status of a barefoot doctor is good. You don't have to miss work, you can earn work points, and the most important thing is that you can have legitimate access to various medicinal materials and medical supplies.These things may come in handy in the future.

“ Moreover, the barefoot doctor walks around every house and can hear all kinds of news.In this day and age, news is opportunity.

"Uncle Su He." Wang Jianxin said, "How many days do you think it is appropriate for me to go to the commune's barefoot doctor training class?"

"Let's go." Su He said, "Three to five days, it won't delay anything."

"That sheep..."

"I'll give it a few days for you."

"Thank you, Uncle Su He."

Su He waved his hands and said nothing.

A few days later, Wang Jianxin rode to the commune.The commune is more than fifty miles away from the production team, and it took most of a day's journey on horseback.

The training class was held in a bungalow in the commune health center.Not many people came, including Wang Jianxin, there were seven in total. They were all educated youths or herdsmen recommended by various production teams.The lecturer was Han Zhiyuan, and the content of the lecture was very simple: how to take a temperature, how to use a stethoscope, how to give an injection, how to deal with trauma, and how to identify several common Chinese herbal medicines.

Wang Jianxin felt a little bored.He has all these things in his mind, and they are much deeper than what Han Zhiyuan talked about.But he still listened carefully and took notes in his notebook from time to time.You can't act too smart, and you can't act too stupid.Just the right amount of nodding, asking questions, taking notes.

During the break, Han Zhiyuan walked up to him and said, "How are you doing? Do you understand?"

"I understand." Wang Jianxin said, "Teacher Han explained it well."

Han Zhiyuan smiled: "I went back and checked the method you used to treat Li Hongmei's dysentery last time. The tannic acid in tea does have an astringent effect, and garlic can kill bacteria. Did your grandpa teach it?"

"Yeah." Wang Jianxin said, "My grandpa said that good medicine is not necessary to cure a disease. If used correctly, things at home can also save lives."

Han Zhiyuan nodded: "Your grandpa is a capable man."

The training course lasts for five days in total.Wang Jianxin attended classes during the day and lived in a small room behind the health center at night.There was only a bed, a table, and a chair in the hut. The walls were covered with newspapers, and the windows were covered with window grilles.

When he had nothing to do at night, he would sit on the bed and practice Qigong.

Still don’t feel it.

He is almost used to it.Sit cross-legged for a while every day and treat it as meditation.If you can't practice it, don't practice it. Anyway, you still have space and medical skills.

On the fifth day, the training class ended.Han Zhiyuan gave everyone a small medicine box, which contained red liquid, purple liquid, iodine, gauze, tape, and a few painkillers.

"Go back and work hard." Han Zhiyuan said, "If you don't understand anything, come to the commune to see me at any time."
